cases.html:
Light audits

Snapshot your rooms + measurements so you can see what a change actually did. Run the tools, save a "Before" audit, make a change (warmer bulbs, blackouts, blue blockers), save an "After". Once you have two, Compare lights up and you'll see the deltas per room.
